thesis: The page is a guided tour through a 1925 Kansas City bungalow: each section is a room behind an arched doorway, and the signature is the floor-plan marker that lights up as you walk through.

signature.name: Room Marker + Arch Frame
signature.summary: A Tudor-arch clip-path frames photos and dividers; a circular room marker with a brass connector line tracks progress through the house. Markers fill on scroll; the arch repeats as structural frame.

motion.intro: Arch mask expands from center (800ms), headline rises beneath (500ms stagger); skippable, content visible at 0ms without JS.
stories: draw: brass connector line draws downward as each room enters (900ms); marker fills with accent
motion.hover: Brass underline grows from left (scaleX 0→1, 200ms) on all interactive elements.
